summary: Fixed Android TEXT touch scrolling: a slow downward drag near the latest message no longer gets snapped back to the bottom by visible-read bookkeeping.

checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'opens text history at latest and advances its read cursor'
